sentence: This project tries to find out whether an AI model has been tampered with so that it produces wrong scientific answers.
This project studies how wildfire changes soil properties and hydrological processes and how these recover over time.
This project combines cybersecurity coursework with hands-on work using AI to defend live university networks and detect cyber threats.
This project develops a treatment that guides skeletal stem cells in joint tissues to regenerate healthy hyaline cartilage.
This project studies whether the microorganisms in the gut of wild nonhuman primates are linked to their behavior.
This project maintains a collection of mutant lines of a model legume plant so researchers worldwide can study what genes do.
This project studies how mobile robots plan their motion and find their position in rural areas with harsh terrains.
This project studies why tightly packed thin shells move in a disordered way as they deploy and how to control it.
This project develops cybersecurity curricula that use AI and builds partnerships between education and industry.
This project studies how an attacker could replay a person's heart signals captured by video to fool a wearable device and builds a defense.
This project studies how electrons tunnel in atoms and molecules under a strong laser field and whether the tunneling takes time.
This project uses AI and experiments to design hydrogel composites with controlled flow behavior for bioprinting tissue repairs.
This project uses tensors, which are multidimensional matrices, to make machine learning more scalable and easier to interpret.
This project develops methods that combine measurements arriving at different times to track the operating state of power distribution systems.
This project develops a framework that helps deep learning models recognize wireless signals correctly even under adversarial attacks.
This project improves Mixed Membership models so they can combine several data sources and predict how human activities affect biodiversity.
This project builds a miniaturized sensor on a silicon chip that detects bacteria quickly without cell culturing.
This project grows heart and skin organoids with blood vessel-like channels to see how microgravity affects them and the extracellular vesicles they release.
